faq_heading: Homes near Holly Elementary in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Holly Elementary in Surrey catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Holly Elementary in Surrey home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Holly Elementary in Surrey, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Holly Elementary in Surrey sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 110 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,059,000, townhomes $585,000, condos $485,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Holly Elementary in Surrey?
faq.a: For the 110 homes that sold within 1 km of Holly Elementary in Surrey, the median time on the market was 34 days and the median sale was 96.8% of list; 6% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Holly Elementary in Surrey?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.5 km north-west), Hjorth Road Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and Guildford Park Secondary (0.8 km west).

Holly Elementary in Surrey is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10719 150 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Holly Elementary in Surrey, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Holly Elementary in Surrey search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Holly Elementary in Surrey, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Holly Elementary in Surrey sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 110 homes sold within 1 km of Holly Elementary in Surrey: 30 houses, 49 townhomes and 31 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $585,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Surrey

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Surrey in a straight line (18 elementary, 5 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Ecole Riverdale Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is North Surrey Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Guildford Park Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Iqra School (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.5 km north-west), Hjorth Road Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Ellendale Elementary (1.2 km north-west), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.2 km west), Dogwood Elementary (1.4 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ecole Riverdale Elementary, 0.5 km north-west of Holly Elementary in Surrey.
